procedure.activationAndGeometry: KEEP Abjuration6, Action,60feet,V/S/F,base13RP and concentration up to60elapsed seconds. NEW choose a fixed vertical rectangular wall up to30feet wide and15feet high, with1foot thickness, resting on actual ground. Choose its full position/orientation before commitment; every point must be within60feet and caster line of effect at formation. Width and height use whole5foot panels, producing at most18panels. No curved dome, moving wall or physical material is supplied. The initial volume must be free of creature bodies and solid terrain; known conflict fails preflight, a hidden conflict discovered at resolution defeats the whole paid formation. The wall is visible but transparent to ordinary sight/sound and does not itself supply cover.
procedure.eligibility: NEW PB-PRED-01, scoped only to this wall: a creature qualifies if an actual operative source explicitly classifies it as extraplanar, or an actual established native-plane relationship places its native plane elsewhere than the wall's plane. A mere current visitor is not assigned a native plane. A record that expressly changes/suppresses that classification is honored for its stated duration. Without either affirmative established basis, this wall imposes no blocking branch; that operational absence is not proof the creature is native or non-extraplanar. Elemental, Fey, Fiend, Humanoid, summoned, outsider and extraplanar are not interchangeable labels. The Director may record a genuinely NEW campaign creature classification explicitly before play, but may not claim it was recovered from cosmology or infer it from a hidden soul theory.
procedure.physicalCrossing: An operative panel blocks a qualifying creature's attempted voluntary or forced physical crossing at its boundary, including that body carried, dragged, grappled or ridden by another. Every separately transported creature retains its own eligibility; hiding a qualifying passenger under a cloak does not turn it into gear. Stop the actual crossing transaction before any qualifying body intersects the panel; no part is severed, squeezed through by changing its name, or left behind without an independently legal release. Movement used to reach the boundary remains spent; impossible remaining movement is not performed. A nonqualifying carrier can release the passenger through its actual available action and move alone if then legal. Nonqualifying bodies, ordinary objects, air, sound and actual attacks pass under their own rules. Going around a real edge remains possible. The wall deals no damage, imposes no extra save and grants no free force or opportunity attack.
procedure.fallingAndPlacement: NEW selective-wall limitation: it supplies no horizontal support. Unsupported falling continues through its top/bottom and uses the ordinary real Falling history; the wall does not become a one-foot-wide platform or halt a Fall Marker. A lateral forced crossing can stop while the creature continues to fall along its actual remaining vertical trajectory. Actual other terrain/support still matters. The wall does not reserve a berth or eject a body when eligibility changes. If an existing body becomes qualifying while intersecting a panel, that entire5x5panel becomes pending for that wall until no qualifying body intersects it; it supplies no blocking while pending. Once clear it resumes prospectively, with no crushing, relocation, missed action, damage or refreshed duration.
procedure.teleportAndTerminalReturn: The wall checks an actual transport destination footprint against its operative thickness for qualifying creature bodies; a destination that intersects is barred by this scoped magical endpoint-prevention rule. A fitting destination beyond the wall does not cross a fictitious physical path and is permitted unless another actual rule prevents that transport. An origin alone touching the wall does not bar leaving. Apply each transport source's normal atomic failure/payment rule. Ordinary Banishment's accepted BAN-CLOSE-03 terminal return expressly overrides endpoint transport prevention: this wall cannot keep that ended cell open. It does not remove real terrain or other bodies. If that mandatory return legally places a qualifying body in the wall thickness, the occupied panel becomes pending under the rule above; no general voluntary-transit bypass is granted.
procedure.suppressionAndEnding: The wall is a nonphysical ongoing rank6 spell with one parent source and its explicit panels. Local suppression makes intersected panels inactive while its original clock and concentration continue. At resumption, a panel occupied by a qualifying creature remains pending until clear. Entry/resumption is not an attack or a new casting. Losing an underlying ground support invalidates the panels depending on it for the remainder of this cast; it does not move or drop a physical wall. One active Planar Barrier per caster; normal concentration commitment and successful replacement rules apply. Expiry, concentration ending or eligible whole-source dispel ends all panels. No saleable fragments, teleport, planar knowledge or permanent ownership boundary remain.

procedure.access: KEEP one source identity with two fully distinct printed operations. procedure.alignmentAndBonus: At successful resolution snapshot the caster's actually defined effective complete alignment pair after accepted underlying history/overlays. If either axis is genuinely undefined, the paid cast establishes no Nexus and supplies no alignment diagnosis. This pair never changes for that application. A creature benefits only when its actual current complete effective pair matches at the creation of an eligible roll. NEW the Nexus insight benefit is +2 to that creature's actual attack-roll, saving-throw and ability-task modifier, before rolling. It changes no AC, damage, DC, HP, RP, rank, critical range, proficiency, automatic result or fixed opposed total. The source's actual normal resolution and information rules still apply. A reroll/replacement of that same original event retains its original modifier set under its own source, rather than resnapshotting alignment to ratchet a bonus.
procedure.overlapAndIdentity: Both modes share one explicitly NEW family, alignment-nexus.insight. A creature receives at most one+2 from that family at an event, regardless of casts, modes, plane effects or casters; choose the earliest eligible active source for equal applicable benefits. This does not reclassify any unrelated class/item bonus into a new universal stacking family. One active Alignment Nexus per caster across both modes. Beginning either new concentration ends the caster's old concentration under ordinary rules even if the new cast later fails. Other casters retain independent records and clocks.
procedure.readout: Eligibility supplies no public roster, alignment identification, oath permission, compelled choice, belief change or origin inference. Hostile matching creatures can benefit just as allies can. Neither mode rewrites alignment to make a creature qualify. Divination6.formation: NEW fixed30foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within60feet and caster line of effect; concentration up to60elapsed seconds. The chosen center must be on the caster's actual current plane. Its insight benefit reaches eligible creatures with a body portion in the sphere and center-to-body line of effect, including the caster if eligible. It is a nonphysical magical zone, not illumination, cover, a wall or a new perception sense. It does not move with the caster.
Divination6.events: Check actual current plane, geometry, line of effect and effective alignment when each attack/save/task roll event is created. Entering/leaving, changing alignment or losing local eligibility changes future roll eligibility without a free new roll, spell cast or Action. No entry pulse, charge reserve, duration gift or lasting buff is acquired. Extra turns can contain genuine eligible rolls but create no special bonus budget. Partial local suppression removes only the affected current benefit; its clock and parent concentration continue.
Divination6.ending: Ordinary expiry, concentration ending, replacement or an actual eligible whole-source removal ends the zone. It has one rank6 parent record, not a list of separately cast spells. A fixed zone with no independent creature-target branch is ineligible for Xi's creature-branch ending. It gives no distant roll readout or retroactive revision of a completed roll.

Conjuration8.destinationAndSourceChoice: NEW full portal operation, not an insight zone substituted for travel. Choose an actually different plane and a specific destination place whose real physical layout the caster has personally perceived, either by visiting or through a source-authorized ordinary visual view such as Planar Window. A mere map name, secondhand direction, imagined ideal, omen or invented cosmology is insufficient to locate an endpoint. The Director records genuine stable origin/destination plane identities privately; distinct labels alone cannot pass the different-plane condition. Choose exact two opening faces and arrival spaces before commitment. Unknown or changed real destination conditions are resolved after paid commitment with no diagnostic report or substitute plane.
Conjuration8.newEmpowermentInterpretation: NEW consequential interpretation for joint review: the spell temporarily makes the selected destination plane empower creatures matching the cast's snapshotted pair, rather than requiring or asserting that the plane is eternally aligned. While this Nexus operates, its +2 insight benefit applies to every actually eligible creature physically on that destination plane, including preexisting inhabitants and enemies, whenever a qualifying roll occurs. This is deliberately plane-wide to retain the full destination-empowerment promise; it is not reduced to a receiving-pad buff. Conjuration8.openings: NEW concentration up to600elapsed seconds. Form two fixed, visible vertical rectangular openings, each10feet wide and15feet high, linked face-to-face with a recorded neutral orientation. The whole origin opening and its five-foot-deep receiving clearance must be within120feet and caster line of effect. The remote opening/receiving clearance use the exact known destination layout rather than imaginary cross-plane line of effect. Both openings need actual unoccupied clear physical volume at formation and suitable real destination support for the declared initial users; the spell creates no floor, breathing protection or environmental immunity. A hidden failure prevents the complete portal pair and empowerment after costs are committed. The spell creates no body in the gap and no third intermediate transit plane.
Conjuration8.transit: While both mouths are operative, a whole actual body may cross by spending five feet of available real movement from an adjacent reachable side; the body and its carried noncreature gear must fit the opening and legal receiving space. Ordinary physically permitted squeezing can apply if it truly allows that whole body through, without automatic resizing. Actual independent forced movement can carry a body through if that movement reaches/crosses the opening and all its own permissions remain legal; the Nexus itself compels nothing and grants no free movement. Separate riders/passengers/carried creatures remain separate bodies. A genuinely inseparable group declared by its actual transport situation is one atomic transaction and every body must fit and satisfy its own blockers. Otherwise bodies cross in a fixed actual event order and occupancy can stop later travelers. Real independent objects/projectiles can cross if they fit and possess actual movement/force. No remote stock is duplicated or pulled through merely by opening the gate.
Conjuration8.rangeSightAndAttacks: The open gateway transmits ordinary light and sound along the real unobstructed route through its two apertures. This is a view of the actual destination, not a remote caster body or origin substitution. NEW a genuinely physical nonspell projectile or thrust may pass through the opening with its own legal attack, visibility and remaining range: measure the actual route to the entrance plus from the exit, with zero additional path length for the paired mouth transition. The real attack retains its dealer/root, defenses and event identity. This includes a physical weapon with separately legal magical enhancement; it does not turn its attack into a second cast. A spell or other effect with an actual same-plane targeting/origin restriction keeps it; the gateway does not waive components, concentration, source-origin, target-type or planar limits or authorize casting from the remote mouth. An effect needs its own genuine authority for any nonphysical cross-plane delivery.
Conjuration8.preventionAndFailure: Test each actual transported body's origin and destination against applicable teleport/planar-transition prevention, including Dimensional Anchor, and the actual distinction between voluntary and involuntary travel in the preventing source. This operation is a planar transition and teleportation for these NEW Nexus transit rules; no imaginary intervening-world path is tested. A known invalid transit is not begun. If an obstacle/blocker becomes effective after a valid movement commitment, that transaction stays wholly at its actual origin with already-spent movement/resources retained; no nearest-safe relocation, new destination, partial body or retry occurs. Obstruction of a mouth can block a current transit without ending the entire spell. The gateway grants no universal ward bypass; ordinary Banishment's special terminal closure is unrelated to voluntary Nexus transit.
Conjuration8.suppressionAndClosure: Local suppression intersecting an opening makes that mouth unavailable for transit while the original clock continues. Local suppression at a beneficiary suspends only that creature's current insight expression. Suppression of the caster alone does not automatically end an already established concentration unless its actual source says so. An effect expressly suppressing the entire Nexus suspends both mouths and empowerment within its actual scope. Nothing queues missed moves or bonuses. On expiry, concentration ending, replacement or eligible parent removal, both mouths and all Nexus insight benefits end. Every completed traveler/object remains at its actual current location; there is no automatic return journey, refund or rescue. A transit resolves atomically before or after a closing event under actual event order, never half inside a severed body. If an endpoint's actual containing place ceases to exist, this Nexus ends rather than inventing a location to hold it. Existing source-specific mandatory body settlement remains that other source's responsibility.
Conjuration8.removalAndCustody: Both mouths are addressable manifestations of the same rank8 parent for an actually eligible dispel; ending the parent at either operative mouth ends both and the empowerment. It does not end an independent other Nexus. Plane-wide empowerment is one continuous zone-like effect with no independent creature-target branch, so Xi cannot end the whole plane effect by targeting an arbitrary beneficiary. Ordinary actually applicable narrow suppression/removal sources retain their own scope. All real cargo, bodies, personal custody, permits and institutional consequences remain real on the side where they are. Neither an unseen native population nor private plane facts are reported by the benefit.
